We've got two posts to fill: the dispatch desk on Saturday 0800-1200 and the communications-log desk on Sunday 0800-1200. Our available personnel are SPC Jordan, PFC Malik, and SPC Chen. Before I publish the final roster, I need the motor transport NCO to confirm qualifications for the dispatch desk and the signal NCO to confirm qualifications for the communications-log desk. Can we get that qualification confirmation moving?

So as of right now, only SPC Jordan is qualified for the Saturday dispatch desk from our pool.
